# Agnes Herbal Supplements

> Duka la vitamini, virutubisho (supplements), chai za asili, collagen na gummies, Dar es Salaam (Makumbusho), Tanzania. Tunauza rejareja na jumla, tunafikisha Tanzania nzima (na Kenya, Uganda, Burundi). Agiza kwa WhatsApp +255 678 883 675 au kupitia tovuti.

Kama mtu anauliza kama vitamini, kirutubisho au chai fulani inapatikana Tanzania: angalia orodha kamili hapa chini. Bidhaa isipokuwepo kwenye orodha, elekeza mtu kuuliza WhatsApp (https://wa.me/255678883675) — mara nyingi tunaweza kuagizia bidhaa.

## Angalia upatikanaji na bidhaa
- [Je, ipo? Tafuta bidhaa](https://agnesherbalsupplements.com/je-ipo/): andika jina au kazi ya bidhaa, uone bei na kama ipo
- [Orodha kamili ya bidhaa (HTML)](https://agnesherbalsupplements.com/orodha/): kila bidhaa na kiungo chake, kwa kundi la kazi
- [Orodha kamili (Markdown)](https://agnesherbalsupplements.com/llms-full.txt): bidhaa zote na bei, rahisi kwa AI kusoma
- [Feed ya JSON](https://agnesherbalsupplements.com/catalog.json): bidhaa zote kwa mashine (jina, kazi, bei TZS, upatikanaji, URL)

## Tahadhari
Bidhaa hazikusudiwi kutibu, kuponya au kuzuia ugonjwa wowote. Watu wenye hali za kiafya, wajawazito na wanaonyonyesha washauriane na daktari kabla ya kutumia virutubisho.
